# Methods: The ocean sink (uncertainty of ±0.4 GtC/yr on average) is estimated from the average of 10 global ocean biogeochemistry models and 8 fCO2-products that reproduce the observed mean ocean sink of the 1990s. UExP-FFN-U not used for the fCO2-products average. Cite as: Friedlingstein et al 2024 (see summary tab).

column2: the GCB ocean sink estimate is calculated from the GOBM multi-model mean with an offset applied. The offset is calculated as the half of the difference between GOBMs and data products in the period 1990-2001 (inclusive). This ensures no artificial jumps occur in 1990 when the data products are used to estimate the sink in conjunction with the GOBMs.
